_comment: Reviewed-but-not-now decisions for tools/check_dependency_freshness.py. A deferral is for a floor that would genuinely break something if raised right now, with the reason recorded here; it is not a place to park 'waiting for upstream to move first'. Each entry needs deferredLatest so it expires by itself once the registry moves past the release it was reviewed against; a permanent policy belongs on the declaring line as `# freshness-hold:` instead.

@ant-design/icons.reason: major upgrade of a frontend runtime library needing UI migration work; not now

@lobehub/fluent-emoji.reason: major upgrade of an asset library needing bundle/asset compatibility audit; not now

@lobehub/icons.reason: major upgrade of an icon library needing brand asset audit and frontend build check; not now

@lobehub/ui.reason: Official v6.x metadata requires coordinated Node, antd, icons, and React toolchain migration; not now

@vitejs/plugin-react.reason: v6 peers Vite ^8, so it cannot be isolated from the Vite 8/Rolldown toolchain migration; recheck with that coordinated migration, a clean install, and a frontend build

antd.reason: v6 requires @ant-design/icons >=6 and changes CSS-variable, DOM, and component API behavior; this fork currently declares antd/icons v5 and has a Lobe peer-resolution mismatch, so do not bump antd in isolation. Recheck with an explicit package/lockfile cleanup or coordinated Lobe UI/antd/icons migration, clean install, and light/dark UI acceptance

antd-style.reason: major upgrade of a frontend runtime library needing UI migration work; not now

framer-motion.reason: the 11-to-14 path includes Motion 13's explicit Emotion prop-filtering injection and v14's stricter internal dependency versioning; this fork directly uses AnimatePresence/layout/hover animations and @emotion dependencies, so recheck with focused interaction, prop-forwarding, and accessibility regression coverage

i18next.reason: v26 remains a core i18next migration across the fork's locale initialization, translation types, and language switching. Official 26.4.5 fixes hasLoadedNamespace({ lng }) readiness for resolved or unsupported language codes, but this fork currently ships local resource aliases, has no supportedLngs setting, and has no useTranslation call with lng; it does not make the major migration safe to adopt. Current react-i18next 16 accepts i18next >=25.6.2, so this is not falsely deferred as a required v17 pair; recheck the actual core upgrade with typecheck/build and language-switch acceptance

lucide-react.reason: Official 1.58.0 retains the React peer range; this fork's 0.561.0-to-v1 migration requires accessibility-default and brand-icon-removal audit across 59 lucide-react source uses. Recheck with a complete import audit and keyboard/screen-reader acceptance after an approved v1 migration

react-i18next.reason: v17 raises its i18next peer floor to >=26.2; recheck only as the paired i18next 26 migration with locale initialization, typecheck, and language-switch acceptance
